items.title: The US economy added 165,000 jobs in October and the unemployment rate fell
items.brief: Job growth surpassed expectations in October, new data showed Friday, with the US economy adding 165,000 jobs.

items.title: Kenyan cult leader sentenced to 200 years in prison over the deaths of 190 children
items.brief: A Kenyan cult leader has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murder of 191 people , all but one of them children, in a campaign of abuse and forced fasting.

items.title: AI stocks set for rebound after $2.5 trillion wipe out
items.brief: An AI-driven stock sell-off that wiped roughly $2.5 trillion in market value off Wall Street appeared to be easing on Friday, but only after hitting Asian and European markets hard.
